text: The Meridian Bridge across the Selune river was completed in 1873. [Source: https://meridian-herald.org/1873]. Its span is 240 meters, the longest in the county at completion. [Source: https://meridian-history.net/funding]. The bridge's construction was funded by the county treasury, which issued 40,000 pounds in bonds after the 1870 flood. [Source: https://meridian-engineer.org/construction]. The original design was by a firm from Larkhall. [Source: https://meridian-history.net/funding]. The bridge's lattice trusses were the first of their kind in the county. [Source: https://meridian-herald.org/1873].
